column1: # Nevers key no.47 (BnF fr.3995, Gallica ark btv1b525085665, canvas f173 = fol.89r, title 'Cifra col S.r Cau. Giac.o Graty', Italian, 1592). Numbering: Tomokiyo nevers.htm.

# Transcription only. Page is upright. Alphabet: symbols (single figures 8..2, 4, 9, 0 and letter forms) under plain-letter headings, vowels with up to three homophones; NOT a digit-pair cipher. Marks: '.NN' = dotted two-figure nomenclator code (dot above the first digit on every entry); 'E-SIGN', 'l-LOOP', 'f-BAR', 'THETA' name glyphs I could not map to a plain character (M). Superscripts in [ ].

# Grade H = two independent reads (mine + one blind Sonnet pass) agree; M = they differ or the glyph is unresolved. Also on the page: 'Babuino' (syllables ba be bi bo bu = vowel symbol over 7) and the note 'et sic de singulis consonantibus'.
